hooks.prompt: You are checking whether Claude followed the RetailAgentOps project logging protocol. Inspect the Stop event in $ARGUMENTS, especially stop_hook_active and last_assistant_message. If stop_hook_active is true, return {"ok": true} to avoid a reminder loop. Otherwise, decide whether the completed turn reports a material implementation, experiment, failure, blocker, phase transition, design decision, constraint change, or rejected alternative. For such a turn, require last_assistant_message to state either that docs/PROJECT_LOG.md was updated with a LOG identifier, or that no log entry was needed with a concrete reason. Read-only analysis, routine successful commands, status-only replies, and formatting-only edits do not require a log entry. If last_assistant_message is missing, empty, or otherwise not evaluable, return {"ok": true} rather than erroring. Return {"ok": true} when the disposition is present or no trigger occurred. Otherwise return {"ok": false, "reason": "Before stopping, apply the logging triggers in CLAUDE.md and append the material event to docs/PROJECT_LOG.md, then report its LOG identifier."}.
